title: authorable-rag-snippet-templates-and-embed-playground
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Add a new authorable snippet template library and an embeddable playground for documentation and quickstarts. No breaking API changes. Introduces optional client-side playground script and new docs pages under /playground and /templates.
description: Adds an author-focused collection of RAG snippet templates plus a lightweight embeddable playground component that lets authors and integrators preview tool-calling flows inline in docs. Motivation: reduce friction for onboarding new users by surfacing runnable, editable RAG examples that demonstrate tool contracts, index pointers, and structured output validation. This PR includes: a library of 14 templates (search + tool-call, multi-step citation, incremental-indexing pattern), an embeddable sandbox iframe + JS shim with strict origin policy, docs pages for authoring and publishing templates, a short how-to for adding templates to existing quickstarts, lint rules for snippet safety, and a small e2e smoke harness used by CI. Checklist: 1) Template schema and examples added, 2) Playground shim and iframe loader added with opt-in telemetry, 3) Docs pages and quickstart author guide added, 4) Unit + e2e tests for sandboxing and example render, 5) Accessibility checks for playground controls. Backwards compatibility: templates are opt-in; existing quickstarts unchanged unless authors wire in the loader. Security notes: iframe enforces sandbox attributes, all tool-call network requests go through the platform proxy; authorable templates are validated by a content linter to remove hard-coded secrets. See related Linear items ENG-1023 and PM-411.
